messages:
Nina (growth): Quick huddle on the benchmark narrative for the email + webinar. want something crisp that maps latency <-> $ impact.
Ravi (design): Thinking a single hero viz: a price vs latency curve with three highlighted points (hosted, dedicated, private). interactive in webinar, static in post.
Lena (analytics): I can produce the curve using our model set. will include short/med/long token profiles. CSV ready in 10m.
Diego (product): Core message: "predictable latency, predictable cost." but need a punchier headline. also include routing/fallbacks as a reliability proof.
Tess (ops): From infra: our routing policy drops tail latency 95p by ~30% when fallback enabled. recommend a tiny callout box: "fallbacks keep apps online."
Nina (growth): Headline options: 1) "Fast, at scale. Affordable, by design." 2) "Choose the latency you need — pay for what matters." prefer 1) for paid channels.
Ravi (design): For social cards keep it to 7-10 words. Also prepare a compact gif showing the slider moving the tradeoff.
Lena (analytics): Experiment idea: two landing variants - one emphasizes latency metrics, other emphasizes $/k tokens. track MQLs and product trials. add a "we care about latency" checkbox to route leads.
Diego (product): Agreed. Route lat-sensitive leads to pre-sales who handle Dedicated/private demos. We should include two templated pitch lines for SDRs.
Tess (ops): I'll draft the infra blurb and attach the sim output. want to flag the assumptions (seq length distribution, model family).
Nina (growth): Assets + copy owners? I ll do the blog and webinar copy, Ravi design, Lena analytics/dashboards, Diego SDR templates, Tess infra notes.
Ravi (design): Timeline: wireframes by Wed, final assets by Fri. GIF and interactive spec for the frontend demo needed by Thu so engineers can prototype.
Lena (analytics): I'll publish the data sheet to shared drive and a small reproducible notebook. link when done.
Diego (product): Webinar flow: 1) problem framing (latency uncertainty), 2) demo (slider + routing), 3) customer mini-case, 4) Q&A. need customer quote.
Nina (growth): I'll ask pilot customers for a short blurb about predictability. if none, stage a clear hypothetical use case with numbers.
Tess (ops): Note: do not promise specific ms SLAs in marketing copy. use ranges and "typical" language. ops will sign off on any figure.
WebhookBot: Reminder: demo environment created at 1748130000.
Nina (growth): CTA plan: webinar signups -> two CTAs post-webinar (request a demo / get a cost estimate). Lena will wire UTM tags.
Lena (analytics): UTMs: utm_campaign=econ_cheatcode_latency and _cost. baseline conversion targets uploaded to the dashboard.
Ravi (design): For the blog lead image: please avoid clichE9 server rack photos. prefer abstract curve + slider.
Nina (growth): Final agree: test latency-first in paid ads, cost-first in organic. capture the latency importance field for inbound routing. follow-up sync Tue.
Diego (product): I'll draft the SDR two-line templates and drop them in the shared doc tonight.
Tess (ops): I'll sanity-check the numbers before anything goes live.
Nina (growth): Thanks team. short & measurable: that s the goal. cheers.
